description: This file implements the XRFCStore class, which manages configuration data related to RFC (Remote Function Call) features, including loading, saving, clearing, and caching configuration parameters, with thread synchronization and file handling.

classes.name: XRFCStore
classes.description: A singleton class managing RFC configuration parameters, including loading from files, caching, thread-safe updates, and clearing data.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Clears all stored RFC data and resets the cache.

methods.name: reloadCache
methods.description: Reloads configuration data from files into cache, and merges local settings.

methods.name: getRawValue
methods.description: Retrieves the raw value of a configuration parameter, considering non-persistent and persistent data.

methods.name: setRawValue
methods.description: Sets a raw configuration value, updating the file if not in update mode.

methods.name: writeHashToFile
methods.description: Writes a key-value pair to a configuration file, updating the in-memory dictionary.

methods.name: clearValue
methods.description: Removes a parameter from local and main configuration caches, with thread synchronization.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a parameter, with fallback to defaults if not found.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a parameter, handling special cases and thread safety.

methods.name: initTR181PropertiesFileName
methods.description: Initializes the filename for TR181 properties from a configuration file.

methods.name: init_rfcdefaults
methods.description: Loads RFC default configurations from the specified directory into a combined file.

methods.name: loadFileToCache
methods.description: Loads key-value pairs from a file into a cache (unordered_map).

methods.name: loadTR181PropertiesIntoCache
methods.description: Loads all relevant configuration files into cache, including handling synchronization and defaults.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the singleton instance, loading configuration files and cache.

methods.name: XRFCStore
methods.description: Constructor initializing the class and loading configuration.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of XRFCStore.
